warning.titlePre: Mercedes GLE350d Swirl Flap & Injector Wear
paragraphs: If your GLE350d is a pre-2019 model with the OM642 diesel V6 — that's the W166 generation — swirl flap and injector wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine, backed by multiple manufacturer technical service bulletins. We replace worn swirl flaps, injector seals and the timing chain as standard on every OM642 rebuild.
The newer V167 generation uses a different engine, the OM656, which doesn't share this specific issue — it's a separate, more recent design.
warning.source: Source: established specialist pattern, multiple TSBs, per VRF-mercedes-gle-class.md. OM656 explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF, correctly scoped to generation
